compliance.processingLocal: Free online PDF tools. Your files are processed on your own device and never uploaded to a server.

isFree.question: Does PDF4Me cost anything?
isFree.answer: No. The tools are free to use, you do not need an account, and we do not add a watermark to the files you produce.

areFilesSecure.question: Where are my files processed, and are they sent anywhere?
areFilesSecure.answer: Files are opened and processed inside your browser on your own device, and they are not uploaded to a PDF4Me server. Some tools download their processing engine (WebAssembly) the first time you use them. The signing and timestamp tools may contact a certificate authority or timestamp server; the document itself is not sent.

platforms.question: Which phones and computers does it work on?
platforms.answer: Any device with an up-to-date browser: Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS or Android. Everything runs on your own device's memory, so very large files can be slow on an older phone.

gdprCompliant.question: Can I use it for papers with personal details, like ID cards or contracts?
gdprCompliant.answer: Files are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to a server, so the content of your papers does not pass through our systems. Still, use your own device and close the tab when you finish, especially on a shared computer.

dataStorage.question: Do you keep my files or a history of what I did?
dataStorage.answer: The standard tools do not send files to a server, so we hold no copy of them. A few preferences, such as language and keyboard shortcuts, are stored in your own browser, and you can clear them any time by clearing the site's data.

different.question: How do I combine several documents into one application file?
different.answer: If your papers are photos or scans, turn them into PDFs with the image to PDF tools first. Then open Merge PDF, add the files, drag them into the right order and download the combined file.

browserBased.question: The portal I'm submitting to has a size limit. How do I shrink my file?
browserBased.answer: Open Compress PDF, choose a file and a compression level, then download the result, and check that the text is still readable before you submit. There are also shortcuts that aim for a target size such as 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB or 2MB.

analytics.question: Can I put a password on a PDF or sign it digitally?
analytics.answer: Yes. The password tool encrypts the file in your browser, and the digital signature tool lets you sign with your own certificate. Your passwords and private keys are not sent to PDF4Me.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine whole files, or select specific pages to merge into a new document.
fileModeInstructions: Click and drag the icon to change the order of the files.
In the "Pages" box for each file, you can specify ranges (e.g., "1-3, 5") to merge only those pages.
Leave the "Pages" box blank to include all pages from that file.
pageModeInstructions: All pages from your uploaded PDFs are shown below.
Simply drag and drop the individual page thumbnails to create the exact order you want for your new file.
